This 45-year-old male with Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, acromegaly, and recurrent peptic ulcer disease presents for follow-up following his recent emergency department evaluation for upper gastrointestinal bleeding in July 2022.
He was diagnosed with peptic ulcer disease six weeks ago and started on a medication that has led to significant improvement in his epigastric pain and reflux symptoms.
However, he now reports new-onset breast tenderness and a small amount of breast tissue development on physical exam.
He is adherent to his ulcer treatment and reports no further episodes of melena or hematemesis.
